summary: Backend-only iteration 4 validating the 24-feature Chatly pass. 38 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_features.py cover: auth extras (/auth/me, /auth/username-available auth-gate, /auth/session rejects invalid session_id, /auth/forgot-password 200 for known email), message idempotency via client_message_id on POST /api/chats/{id}/messages AND POST /api/sync/messages?chat_id= (repeat POST returns same message_id, only 1 DB row), offline pull GET /api/sync/pull (returns messages + server_time; since=future filters to empty), Priority + Smart Inbox (PATCH /api/messages/{id}/priority=important reflects in GET /api/inbox/smart?category=important; groups dict includes all 5 priority buckets), AI Autopilot rules CRUD (create/list/patch/delete), autopilot analyze + confirm (priority + reminder paths), smart features unread-catchup/digest/smart-reminder-suggest/follow-ups, Group AI assistant enforces group-only (400 for DM, 200 for group), decision-maker analyze + full poll lifecycle create/list/vote/switch-vote/close with winner surfaced in final_decision, invalid option_id -> 400, calls lifecycle voice/video start->accept->end and start->reject, GET /api/calls list, GET /api/calls/ice-servers returns Google STUN (stun.l.google.com) + Metered TURN (openrelay.metered.ca) with username+credential, transcript-text upload + retrieval, /calls/{id}/ai summary via Sarvam, feedback POST/GET/mine, analytics batch (accepted count for allowed events, rejected for unknown), push register 201/503 for self and 403 when spoofing another user_id, GET /api/firebase/status returns ready:true, all new endpoints reject unauth (401/403/422). Result: 38/38 PASSED (100%) in 9.75s. AI endpoints all responded within the 120s budget on this run so no 503 fallback path was exercised — that path is coded and asserted-accepted. Sarvam is the sole AI provider per env (SARVAM_API_KEY set, no OpenAI/Anthropic env).

minor.issue: Contract accepts 200 or 500 depending on whether the email provider (Emergent proxy) blocks the target domain. Consider ALWAYS returning 200 to avoid email-existence enumeration (currently it's 200 for known accounts but a provider outage would leak via 500).
Returns up to 500 messages with no cursor/hasMore field. Clients pulling long histories will silently truncate. Consider adding next_since or has_more to the payload.
Query returns up to 300 messages across ALL chats with no pagination; heavy accounts will render slowly. Add limit/before params.

action_items: (LOW) Return 200 from /auth/forgot-password regardless of provider success to avoid enumeration; log the provider error server-side instead of surfacing 500.
(LOW) Add pagination cursor (next_since / has_more) to /api/sync/pull and /api/inbox/smart to avoid silent truncation past 500/300 rows respectively.
(OPTIONAL) Expose Sarvam call latency in server logs on the AI endpoints (autopilot/analyze, /ai/digest, /ai/unread-catchup, /calls/{id}/ai) so slow Sarvam responses can be traced without a 502.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_routes.send_message correctly implements client_message_id idempotency via a scoped find_one({chat_id, sender_id, client_message_id}) before persisting; POST /api/sync/messages delegates to the same handler so both paths are consistent — good.

smart_features_routes.confirm_autopilot separates suggestion_type into 'priority' (updates message) vs 'reminder'/'follow_up' (creates reminder). Bodies with an unknown suggestion_type are rejected at the Pydantic layer (regex pattern) — good defense.

smart_features_routes.vote_poll pulls the voter from ALL options first (options.$[].votes) then $addToSet on the chosen one — cleanly enforces one-vote-per-user with switch semantics. No race protection but acceptable for a demo poll surface.

calls_routes.ice_servers reads STUN_URLS/TURN_URLS from env with sensible defaults (Google STUN + Metered openrelay). Credentials are shipped unless the env explicitly clears them — matches the review spec (Metered free TURN + Google STUN).
feedback_routes has an explicit ALLOWED_EVENTS whitelist for /analytics/event and props are truncated to 120 chars, keys<=40 chars, max 16 keys — good privacy/DoS guard.
push_routes.register_push blocks spoofed user_id with 403 BEFORE calling the provider — verified by test.
smart_features_routes.group_assistant correctly 400s on non-group chats — verified by test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (38/38 iteration-4 tests). AI endpoints (Sarvam) all replied within timeout on this run; the coded 503 fallback was not needed.
success_rate.frontend: N/A - backend-only testing per review request
